title: Tamron's 20-40mm f/2.8 Comes to Nikon Z
excerpt: Tamron's compact 20-40mm f/2.8 wide zoom arrives for Nikon Z on October 22 for $729, giving full-frame shooters a light, fast wide-to-normal zoom with an unusual range.

title: Camera Raw's New Grid View Is the Catalog-Free Workflow You Already Own
excerpt: Adobe added a grid view with ratings and filters to Camera Raw, plus exposure matching that reads your camera's ambient light data — no Lightroom catalog required.

title: Sigma's 50-120mm f/2.8 Is the APS-C Zoom We've Been Waiting For
excerpt: Sigma's new 50-120mm f/2.8 gives APS-C shooters a 390-gram, $799 portrait-and-events zoom, completing an affordable constant-aperture trio.
